editorial.blurb: This cozy neighborhood Thai spot delivers authentic flavors with real skill — fresh, flavorful, and perfectly balanced between heat and taste.
editorial.insiderTip: The space is intimate and small, so order takeout if you're coming with a group, and don't sleep on the yellow sauce that comes with the spring rolls — it's genuinely addictive.
signatureDishes: Pad kee mao mama noodles with crispy pork
